body:
Follow-up 3 to the peer-prediction verification-markets package: adds an `intermittent` on/off adversary that defeats symmetric rolling trust, and an asymmetric ("fast down, slow up") rolling-trust update that cuts the Brier excess ~18% at 0.5 defection and ~30% at 0.75. Costs and caveats (honest-only Brier 0.0017 -> 0.0019; no gain at 0.25 defection) are documented in the README. 51 tests pass.
